item.title: Shiogama: Tuna Port, Sunday Market & National Treasure Shrine — Guide
item.description: Shiogama is one of Japan’s top tuna-landing ports, supplying much of Tokyo’s premium maguro market — the Sunday morning market at Uontana lets visitors buy directly from wholesalers at extraordinary prices, followed by kaisendon (seafood rice bowls) at restaurants that open at 7am. Above the port, Shiogama Shrine rises on a wooded hill with 202 stone steps, its main halls designated National Treasures. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Shiogama, Miyagi Hours Market Sun ~5:00–13:00; shrine always open Admission Free (market entry); meals extra Time needed 1.
